title: The spherical perceptron with bi-orthogonally invariant disorder
summary: We determine the limiting free energy of a spherical perceptron with a bounded continuous activation and a bi-orthogonally invariant disorder matrix. The singular values may have any compact limiting distribution, provided there are no outliers. We give an explicit variational formula for this limit.
family_title: Perceptron free energies and microscopic jamming exponents

review.reason: Derives the limiting free energy of a spherical perceptron with structured random disorder.
